google_account: demo login identity (the presenter); unchanged from the existing datasets
auth_roles: the four persona roles the app already defines; access notes written for Northline Water Group
credentials: one handle per Azure SQL source (northline_epbcs, northline_psoft, northline_pmo); deterministic
projects: gen/gen_graph_northline.py - 3 Azure SQL sources, 6 datasets, 19 tables; row counts are the invented warehouse’s
audit: authored for the demo week (13 to 19 October 2026)
traces: sealed traces over recorded answers; stats computed from them
evals: computed from ask_answers, the review queue and the sanity checks
change_signals: the graph’s own gaps - what the data cannot support, with the do-not clause
column_profiles: every column of the 19 tables, with profiler statistics; the dictionaries in uploads/05_data_catalog carry the same columns
document_vocabulary: the document-corpus profile of the OneDrive source
drives: the Capital Program folder in OneDrive: 7 folders, 30 documents; page, character and chunk counts measured from the rendered files in drive_corpus/
document_extractions: _build/extractions_northline.py - what the document graph builder reads from each document, resolved to canvas node ids
graph_domains: domains ranked by what the connected data supports
graph_studio: _build/graph_northline.py canvas (concepts, thin instances, measures; spring layout seed 7) + 8 review items with 1 pivot + 5 sanity checks
graph_personas: the personas of the Capital Program Analyst role; top_questions are the hero ids each one asks
graph_hero_questions: every question the Ask answers carry (HQ1 to HQ45)
graph_answer_formats: the block mixes the answers use
graph_use_cases: the one committed role - Capital Program Analyst for Northline Water
ask_answers: _build/answers_northline.py - 49 recorded answers (HQ1 to HQ45 and four extra declines Q46 to Q49); every figure computed from the datasets
reports: _build/gov_northline.py - three reports and their governance; Reports is hidden from the sidebar for every persona, but governance feeds Audit & Governance
settings: the eight demo users (all on the demo login domain) and the nav permissions the app uses today (Reports hidden)
reports_prototype: the Authoring tab fixture - the large projects above 10% and the projects the stories name, in USD millions
data_model: declared relationships between the tables, confirmed by the presenter, plus open suggestions
graph_metrics: the governed measures of the Capital Program Analyst role
mail_corpus: the capital program mailbox - 22 messages in 16 threads (mailbox_export/)
studio_graph: the as-built graph-version shape: structured lane over the selected tables, document lane extracted from the corpus, Bridge type links
